note: Careers (2.0): how a career starts, what it plays for and how it ends. Every number of the career frame is here. Not part of the dataset hash; a career copies what it needs into its save when it starts. See docs/rules/CORPORATE.md, Careers.

richest.note: Richest: the player's net worth at the end over the fortune the career started with (a helm start: the net worth just after buying control), in basis points (10000 = no growth). One row per career length; scenarios lists rows for a scenario whose founders grow at a different pace, and any other scenario uses multiples. The 10 year rows are calibrated on the careful founder's grid in each scenario (2.0 inputs round two, 10 seeds: bronze in about four careers of ten, gold above every measured career); the default row is Great Lakes. 5 and 20 years compound the same yearly growth and are not measured.

biggest.note: Biggest: the company league place at the end, per start. bronze_top_bps, when not 0, also gives bronze to a company in that top share of the league (5000 = the top half).
